args.content:
Hawaii Packing List

Based on Emma Johnson's Hawaii Vacation Itinerary (June 10-20, 2024)

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (for beach days, snorkeling, kayaking)
- Sunscreen (essential for Hawaiian sun)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike)
- Casual outfits (for shopping, dining, and relaxation)
- Camera (to capture beautiful Hawaiian scenery)
- Travel documents (passport, tickets, reservations)

Activity-Specific Items:
- Beach towel and beach bag
- Snorkeling gear (if not renting)
- Comfortable hiking shoes
- Light rain jacket
- Formal outfit for Luau experience
- Waterproof phone case
- Reef-safe sunscreen

Additional Recommendations:
- Sunglasses and hat
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit
- Portable charger
- Reusable water bottle
